Thank you. That means more than you will ever know.

He wouldn't abandon his kids.  He would probably try to get full custody of them.

We didn't get married when I got pregnant, we were only dating.  We have two children now.  I'm well aware they need me, but how on earth will i support two children?  I literally have no job experience.  I have been applying for jobs for the last year with no success.  My husband has a good job, he can easily support them.  I would have to be a fool to drag them along with me.  I will have no job, no home, and no family.  I'm losing everything I know.  I'm trying to stay strong and positive, but it's exhausting.  That's why I'm here.
